summary: Unlock new career opportunities with our Certified Facility Manager Training. Acquire the skills necessary for effective facility management and certification.
lede: Asset and facility management courses cover the operational, strategic and risk-related work involved in managing facilities and property. For mid- to senior-level facility management professionals, this course builds practical skills in sustainable real estate and space planning, facility technology and stakeholder communication, and emergency preparedness and risk planning; it also covers service quality, process improvement and preparation for the CFM exam.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for facility management professionals seeking to enhance their expertise. This course is designed for: Mid- to senior-level FM professionals meeting education and experience requirements.
modules: Part 3: Human Factors and Risk Management in Facility Management
Part 4: Facility Management Excellence and Certification Preparation
prerequisites: To view requirements, visit the IFMA Web site at: www.ifma.org
